requirement_en: Given a non-null integer array, return its length without modifying the array.
Given a non-null integer array, return true exactly when its length is zero.
Given a non-null nonempty integer array, return its first element without modifying it.
Given a non-null nonempty integer array, return its last element without modifying it.
Given a non-null integer array and a valid index, return the element at that index.
Given a non-null integer array, a valid index, and a value, store the value at the index and leave all other elements unchanged.
Given a non-null integer array and two valid indices, swap the two indexed elements.
Given a non-null integer array and a valid prefix length n, set the first n elements to zero and leave the suffix unchanged.
Given a non-null integer array and a value, set every element to that value.
Given a non-null integer array and a target value, return true exactly when some element equals the target.
Given a non-null integer array and a target value, return the first target index or -1 if absent.
Given a non-null integer array and a target value, count occurrences of the target.
Given a non-null integer array, return true exactly when every element is even.
Given a non-null integer array, return true exactly when at least one element is negative.
Given a non-null nonempty integer array, return a maximum element without modifying the array.
Given a non-null nonempty integer array, return a minimum element without modifying the array.
Given non-null source and destination arrays where the destination is long enough, copy all source elements into the destination.
Given a non-null integer array whose elements can be safely incremented, add one to every element.
Given a non-null integer array whose elements can be safely doubled, double every element in place.
Given a non-null integer array, set elements at even indices to zero and leave odd indices unchanged.
Given a non-null integer array and a valid adjacent pair, swap the pair only if it is descending.
Given a non-null integer array of length three, sort the three elements in nondecreasing order in place.
Given two integers, return the greater value.
Given two integers, return the smaller value.
Given an integer other than Integer.MIN_VALUE, return its absolute value.
Given integers x, lo, and hi with lo <= hi, clamp x into the closed interval [lo, hi].
Given two integers whose mathematical sum is inside int range, return their sum.
Given two integers whose mathematical difference is inside int range, return x minus y.
Given three angles, return true exactly when all are positive and their mathematical sum is 180.
Given three side lengths, return true exactly when they satisfy the strict mathematical triangle inequality.
Given n between 0 and 65535, return the arithmetic sum 0 + ... + n.
Given nonnegative a and bounded b, return a*b using repeated addition.
Given an integer array, return its length when non-null and throw IllegalArgumentException when null.
Given integers x and y, return x/y when y is nonzero and division cannot overflow, and throw IllegalArgumentException when y is zero.
Given an array and index, return the indexed element for valid inputs and throw IllegalArgumentException when the array is null or the index is invalid.
Given a possibly null String and a fallback non-null String, return the input when non-null, otherwise the fallback.
Given a non-null mutable Box and a value, update only the box value field.
type_context: public static class Box { public int value; }

requirement_en: Given a non-null mutable Box, return its value without modifying the box.
type_context: public static class Box { public int value; }

requirement_en: Given a non-null Counter whose value can be safely incremented, increment it by one.
Given a non-null Counter, decrement it only when its value is positive and preserve nonnegativity.
Given a non-null Pair, return the sum of its two fields without modifying the object.
type_context: public static class Pair { public int left; public int right; }

requirement_en: Given a non-null Range, return true exactly when x is inside its inclusive bounds.
Given two distinct non-null boxes, update the first box and leave the second box unchanged.
type_context: public static class Box { public int value; }

requirement_en: Given a character, return its decimal digit value when it is between '0' and '9', otherwise throw IllegalArgumentException.

Given three integers, return a value that is at most all three and equal to one of them.

Given x between -46340 and 46340, return x squared.

Given an integer above Integer.MIN_VALUE, return its predecessor.
Given x in the closed interval [lo, hi], return x unchanged.
Given a nonnegative integer x, return its distance from zero.

Given x, lo, and hi with lo < hi, return true exactly when x is strictly between them.
Given a boolean flag and two integers, return x when the flag is true and y otherwise.
Given two booleans, return their conjunction.
Given two booleans, return their disjunction.
Given two booleans, return true exactly when they differ.
Given a boolean, return its negation.
Given two booleans, return true exactly when a implies b.
Given two integers, return true exactly when both are nonzero.
Given two integers, return true exactly when at least one is zero.
Given three integers, return true exactly when all three are positive.
Given a non-null integer array of length at least two, return its second element.
Given a non-null integer array of length at least two, return its penultimate element.
Given a non-null nonempty array whose first and last elements can be safely added, return their sum.
Given a non-null integer array and nonnegative n, return true exactly when the array length is at least n.
Given a non-null nonempty array and a value, store the value in the first element.
Given a non-null nonempty array and a value, store the value in the last element.
Given a non-null nonempty array whose first element can be safely incremented, increment only the first element.
Given a non-null array of length at least two, copy the first element into the last element.
Given a non-null array of length at least two, swap the first and last elements.
Given a non-null length-three array whose elements can be safely summed, return the sum of the three elements.
Given a non-null nonempty array, return true exactly when the first element is zero.
Given a non-null nonempty array, return true exactly when the last element is positive.
Given a non-null array of length three, return its middle element.
Given a non-null array with at least two elements, store x in the first element and y in the second.
Given a non-null array with at least two elements, set its first two elements to zero.
Given a non-null array with at least two elements, return true exactly when the first element is no greater than the second.
Given a non-null String, return its length.
Given a non-null String, return true exactly when its length is zero.
Given a non-null nonempty String, return its first character.
Given a non-null nonempty String, return its last character.
Given a character, return true exactly when it is a lowercase ASCII letter.
Given a character, return true exactly when it is an uppercase ASCII letter.
Given an uppercase ASCII letter, return the corresponding lowercase letter.
Given a character, return true exactly when it is an ASCII digit.
Given an integer x, return x when it is positive and throw IllegalArgumentException otherwise.
Given an integer x, return x when it is nonnegative and throw IllegalArgumentException otherwise.
Given a String and index, return the character at the index for valid inputs and throw IllegalArgumentException otherwise.
Given an array, return its first element when non-null and nonempty, otherwise throw IllegalArgumentException.
Given an array, return its last element when non-null and nonempty, otherwise throw IllegalArgumentException.
Given a character, return it when it is uppercase ASCII and throw IllegalArgumentException otherwise.
Given two integers x and y, return x when x <= y and throw IllegalArgumentException otherwise.
Given an integer below Integer.MAX_VALUE, return its successor and throw IllegalArgumentException at Integer.MAX_VALUE.
